title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
description: Ten named destinations around the nearby Schoen Place, North Main Street, and Monroe Avenue canal corridor in Pittsford.

cards.title: Pittsford Farms Dairy and Bakery
cards.subtitle: North Main Street corridor, Pittsford
cards.notes: Walk the North Main Street side of the canal district and use the bakery’s listed café, pastry, milk, and ice-cream offerings as your reason to stop.
cards.short_summary: A named dairy, bakery, and café stop in the canal-side district.
cards.evidence_claim: Nazareth lists Pittsford Farms Dairy and Bakery at 44 North Main Street and describes homemade ice cream, milk, pastries, and café beverages.
cards.access_notes: Listed at 44 North Main Street, Pittsford.

cards.title: Simply Crêpes
cards.subtitle: Schoen Place corridor, Pittsford
cards.notes: Use Schoen Place for a sit-down crêpe stop; confirm availability or reservations with the restaurant before making a special trip.
cards.short_summary: A named Schoen Place restaurant on the Erie Canal district corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Nazareth lists Simply Crêpes at 7 Schoen Place, Pittsford, 0.6 miles from campus.
cards.access_notes: Nazareth’s listing says to call for reservations.

cards.title: Aladdin's Natural Eatery
cards.subtitle: Schoen Place corridor, Pittsford
cards.notes: Make 8 Schoen Place a meal stop while exploring the canal district; the university identifies the restaurant’s cuisine as Mediterranean.
cards.short_summary: A named Mediterranean restaurant directly on Schoen Place.
cards.evidence_claim: Nazareth lists Aladdin's Natural Eatery, described as Mediterranean cuisine, at 8 Schoen Place in Pittsford.

cards.title: Olives Greek Taverna
cards.subtitle: Schoen Place/State Street corridor, Pittsford
cards.notes: Follow the Schoen Place corridor to the State Street address and use this named Greek taverna as a clearly located food stop.
cards.short_summary: A Greek restaurant at the Schoen Place end of the State Street corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Nazareth lists Olives Greek Taverna at 50 State Street, Schoen Place, Pittsford.
cards.access_notes: Listed at 50 State Street, Schoen Place, Pittsford.

cards.title: Erie Canal Towpath
cards.subtitle: Monroe Avenue and Schoen Place corridor, Pittsford
cards.notes: Start at the listed Monroe Avenue access point and take a daylight walk or ride along the canal towpath; check conditions before setting out.
cards.short_summary: A named canal-side route anchoring the nearby Pittsford corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: The Town of Pittsford business directory lists the Erie Canal Towpath at 3195 Monroe Avenue.
cards.access_notes: Directory location: 3195 Monroe Avenue; use normal trail awareness and observe posted rules.

cards.title: Canal Lock #62
cards.subtitle: Monroe Avenue corridor, Pittsford
cards.notes: Look for the named lock from the Monroe Avenue side of the canal corridor and pair it with a towpath walk rather than treating it as a venue.
cards.short_summary: A map-listed Erie Canal lock on the Monroe Avenue approach.
cards.evidence_claim: The Town of Pittsford business directory lists Canal Lock #62 at 3195 Monroe Avenue.
cards.access_notes: Directory location: 3195 Monroe Avenue; view only from permitted public areas.

cards.title: Sam Patch Boat
cards.subtitle: Schoen Place corridor, Pittsford
cards.notes: Check the packet boat’s current cruise details before planning a canal outing; its listed Schoen Place location makes it easy to pair with the towpath.
cards.short_summary: A named packet-boat destination at Schoen Place.
cards.evidence_claim: The Town of Pittsford business directory lists the Sam Patch Boat at 12 Schoen Place.
cards.access_notes: Directory location: 12 Schoen Place; confirm seasonal operations and ticketing directly.

cards.title: Towpath Bike Rental
cards.subtitle: Schoen Place corridor, Pittsford
cards.notes: Use the listed Schoen Place bike-rental stop as a launch point for a canal outing, then verify rental terms and operating status directly.
cards.short_summary: A named bike-rental destination beside the canal corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: The Town of Pittsford’s Discover Pittsford page identifies Towpath Bike Rental in the Schoen Place Erie Canal area.
cards.access_notes: Located in the Schoen Place Erie Canal area according to the Town’s directory-style map.

cards.entity_name: William A. Carpenter Park at Port of Pittsford
cards.title: William A. Carpenter Park
cards.subtitle: North Main Street/Schoen Place corridor, Pittsford
cards.notes: Pause at the Port of Pittsford park for canal-side public space, then continue toward Schoen Place or North Main Street destinations.
cards.short_summary: A named public park at the Port of Pittsford.
cards.evidence_claim: The Town of Pittsford business directory lists William A. Carpenter Park at Port of Pittsford at 22 North Main Street.
cards.access_notes: Directory location: 22 North Main Street; follow posted park and waterfront rules.

cards.title: Pittsford Community Library
cards.subtitle: State Street/Schoen Place corridor, Pittsford
cards.notes: Use the library as a quiet, named public destination near Schoen Place; check its current calendar and access details before visiting.
cards.short_summary: A named public library near the canal-district corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: The Town of Pittsford’s Erie Canal bicentennial page identifies Pittsford Community Library at 24 State Street.
cards.source_title: Town of Pittsford — Erie Canal Bicentennial
cards.access_notes: Town page gives the location as 24 State Street; confirm current library hours directly.
